list.query:
import "array"
import "dict"
import "generate"
import "regexp"
import "strings"
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

// Latest name and maker of every device the collector knows.
info = from(bucket: "dns")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_info")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
infoDevices = info |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "device")
// Flux has no zip, so columns are paired up by index.
infoIndexes = generate.from(count: length(arr: infoDevices), fn: (n) => n, start: 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2000-01-01T00:00:01Z)
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
toDict = (column) => {
    values = info |> fill(column: column, value: "") |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: column)

    return dict.fromList(pairs: array.map(arr: infoIndexes, fn: (x) => ({key: infoDevices[x], value: values[x]})))
}
nameOf = toDict(column: "name")
// Device keys in the time range, labeled by name. A device without a name
// keeps its key (an IP).
rangeDevices = schema.tagValues(bucket: "dns", tag: "device", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
label = (device) => dict.get(dict: nameOf, key: device, default: device)

array.from(rows: array.map(arr: rangeDevices, fn: (x) => ({_value: label(device: x)})))
  |> sort()

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

// Latest name and maker of every device the collector knows.
info = from(bucket: "dns")
  |> range(start: 0)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ selectedDevices)
sums = data
  |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
  |> sum()
active = data
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "queries")
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> count()

  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")
label = (device) => dict.get(dict: nameOf, key: device, default: device)
selected = array.filter(arr: rangeDevices, fn: (x) => label(device: x) =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
selectedDevices = regexp.compile(v: "^(" + strings.joinStr(arr: array.map(arr: selected, fn: (x) => regexp.quoteMeta(v: x)), v: "|") + ")$")

data = from(bucket: "dns")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_domain" and r._field == "queries")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ selectedDevices)
  |> group(columns: ["device", "site"])
union(tables: [
  data |> sum() |> set(key: "_field", value: "queries"),
  data |> count() |> set(key: "_field", value: "active_minutes")
])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["device", "site"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["active_minutes"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with name: label(device: r.device)}))
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "site", "active_minutes", "queries"])
